breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflict between the specified Dirichlet and periodic boundary conditions. It resolved the issue by omitting the contradictory periodic condition and only including the Dirichlet conditions `u(0,t)=0` and `u(1,t)=0`, which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
